name: quantus-cloud
description: Test stock ideas on real Korean and US data, run your own trading bot on Quantus Cloud, and turn an order sentence into a confirm card. Orders go out only after you press confirm on the Quantus screen.

interface.longDescription: Sign in to Quantus once. Test a stock-picking idea over the longest period the data covers, look at Korean and US stock data, run your own trading bot on Quantus Cloud (upload, start, logs, status, stop), and turn an order sentence into a confirm card. Orders are never sent from chat: you press confirm on the Quantus screen in your own account. Cloud bot tools appear once Quantus Cloud is enabled for your account. Past backtest results do not guarantee future returns, and Quantus does not give investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Backtest Samsung Electronics over the longest period.
Show me the financial snapshot of NVDA.
Make a confirm card to buy 1 share of Samsung Electronics.
